name: Bastille Brasserie & Bar

identity.notes: All restaurant-issued pages/PDFs and linked Toast identify the same Alexandria restaurant; no other location was merged.

sources.excerpt: Official homepage identifies Bastille Brasserie & Bar at 606 N. Fayette St, Alexandria, VA 22314 and links the exact-location menu pages and Toast ordering.
Dinner Tuesday-Sunday, 4:00PM-9:00PM; links DINNER A LA CARTE & PRIX FIXE PDF, PDF PLAT DU MOIS, and Bar & Happy Hour Menu; warns that not all ingredients are listed.
Current two-page $45/$55 prix-fixe and à-la-carte dinner menu for Dinner Tues-Sunday at 606 N Fayette St; item descriptions, GF/GFA/CN legend, and restaurant-level cross-contamination advisory.

Packet-referenced two-page dinner PDF remains accessible and was read completely, but the live Dinner page now links replacement 10574ea1...; it is retained as superseded evidence and does not establish current products independently.
JUILLET-JULY Plat du Mois lists Daurade à la Marocaine and Gâteau Marocain with full display descriptions and 606 N Fayette identity inherited from the official dinner page link.
L’Apero @ Bastille Happy Hour, Menu Valid 06/04/2026, lists Bouchées plus Athletic Brewing non-alcoholic beer; alcohol and spirit-list rows are excluded.
Desserts available during dinner Tuesday-Sunday; links PDF DESSERTS - DINNER and warns that not all ingredients are listed.
Les Desserts, Menu Valid 05/22/2026, itemizes nine desserts plus brewed coffee, espresso, cappuccino, latte and hot tea; dessert/fortified wines are excluded.
Petit Gourmand page for guests 12 and under links the PDF CHILDRENS MENU at the Alexandria address.
Petit Gourmands lists six food/sides, six nonalcoholic drinks and two desserts; Burger Add On and Ask your server for flavors are modifiers/instructions, not products.
Official Beverages page links the current Wine & Spirits PDF; only its Free Spirited, soda and non-alcoholic beer presentations are in POC scope.
Current beverage PDF dated 06/26/2026 lists Free Spirited drinks, sodas, and Athletic Brewing NA Golden Lager/NA IPA; alcoholic cocktails, wine, cider, beer and spirits are excluded.
Linked Toast exact-location catalog at 606 N Fayette St lists 21 Dinner a la carte products and seven Kids Menu products, including Baguette & Butter and Seasonal Vegetables.
Official menu navigation, sitemap/document surfaces, and all six live linked PDFs were inspected; none is a complete item-by-allergen matrix.
Targeted restaurant/domain search for allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, matrix, PDF and menu found official menus and advisories but no complete allergen matrix.

riskSignals.description: No complete allergen matrix exists on the four required search classes; unavailable products remain unknown.
Official dinner menu has broad cross-contamination prose; it is not bound as generic item-level mayContain.
Confit Wings exposes Espelette Buffalo or Miso Honey variants with different explicit positives; no variant-only signal is promoted to fixed product allergens.
Official pages say not all ingredients are listed and items may vary with season/availability.

summary: Corrected Alexandria union contains 67 current food/nonalcoholic products across seven complete current product surfaces, with four restaurant HTML pages retained as supporting navigation. Repeated official/Toast presentations are consolidated; alcohol, modifiers, headings, navigation and ingredients are excluded. All 52 frozen keys reconcile once with no stale claims; 38 direct-positive products retain exact item-level basis notes and 29 products remain unavailable.
